correctness.rationale: Under the displayed S-FSPS specialization A=I, h=0, g=ell_1, z^0=0 and centered box, the Moreau gradient is coordinatewise clip(x/gamma,[-1,1]). For k>=1 the claimed recurrence z_i^k=clip(x_i^k/gamma_{k-1},[-1,1]), x_i^{k+1}=x_i^k-(gamma_k/chi)z_i^k gives, for every nonzero coordinate, a strict step toward but never past zero: in the outer regime gamma_k<=gamma_{k-1}<|x_i^k|; in the inner regime the multiplicative factor is in [1-1/chi,1). Projection thus remains inactive, coordinate signs never flip, and each |x_i^k| decreases. A positive limit would eventually incur the nonsummable losses gamma_k/chi, contradiction; all coordinates tend to zero. Telescoping each monotone coordinate proves exactly sum ||x^{k+1}-x^k||_1=||x^0||_1 and Euclidean finite length for ANY prescribed positive nonincreasing nonsummable gamma_k tending to zero. The packaged rational verifier was inspected and an independent symbolic case split checked. This correctness conclusion is conditional on the stated update being the accurate specialization of equation (6.2), for which the recent original paper was not fully accessible in this execution.
